rules.title: Source-of-income discrimination barred (incl. Section 8 vouchers)
rules.requirement: Landlords cannot refuse to rent to you or give you worse terms because of how you pay rent, including Section 8 vouchers, rental assistance, SSI or job wages. They must complete paperwork required by rental assistance programs and cannot advertise "No Section 8."
rules.requirement_es: Los arrendadores no pueden negarse a alquilarle ni imponerle peores condiciones por la forma en que paga la renta, incluidos los vales de la Sección 8, la asistencia para la renta, el SSI o el salario. Deben completar los formularios que exigen los programas de asistencia y no pueden anunciar "No Sección 8".
rules.quoted_span: California law protects tenants from discrimination based on how a tenant will be paying rent (“source of income”).
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to most housing providers, including landlords, property managers and tenant screening companies.
rules.exemptions: Owner-occupied home renting to one additional person may exclude applicants on protected characteristics (but not advertise discriminatorily).
rules.penalty: Remedies include out-of-pocket losses, injunction, emotional distress damages, civil penalties or punitive damages, attorney's fees.
rules.caveat: Secondary agency summary (FEHA); statute citation is approximate and not given in the document.

rules.title: Limits on criminal-history screening of rental applicants
rules.requirement: Landlords cannot consider arrests that did not lead to conviction, sealed or expunged records, or juvenile records, and cannot have blanket bans on applicants with a criminal history. A denial based on a conviction must be directly related to being a good tenant and not a threat to safety or property.
rules.requirement_es: Los arrendadores no pueden considerar arrestos sin condena, registros sellados o eliminados, ni registros de menores, y no pueden tener prohibiciones generales contra solicitantes con antecedentes penales. Negar una solicitud por una condena debe estar directamente relacionado con ser buen inquilino y no representar una amenaza para la seguridad o la propiedad.
rules.quoted_span: Housing providers cannot consider some types of criminal history including arrests that did not lead to a conviction, records that are sealed or expunged, or records or matters processed in the juvenile justice system.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to most housing providers under FEHA, including third-party tenant screening companies.
rules.caveat: Secondary agency summary (FEHA); specific statute/regulation citation is not given in the document and is approximate.
